Commonwealth PhD scholarship

This award supports eligible applicants from specified Commonwealth countries undertaking full-time doctoral study in the UK. Apply through an approved nominating organisation as well as the Commission’s application process; nominators can set earlier deadlines.

Funding

The award covers full tuition and provides a monthly living allowance of GBP 1,712 outside London or GBP 2,000 in London at the currently published rates. Approved airfare and specified study-related allowances are also available under the award rules. Funding normally lasts 36 months.

Eligibility

Country, residency, academic and financial-need conditions apply. Check the official country list and nomination instructions. This is not a scholarship for every Commonwealth nationality.

English and award conditions

The Commission does not require IELTS, but your university can require separate English-language evidence. Read the return-home and immigration conditions before planning post-study employment.

Deadline

The Commission closes applications on 20 October 2026 at 16:00 BST. Confirm your nominator’s earlier internal deadline.

Official scholarship requirements and application instructions

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 20 October 2026, 16:00 BST. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
